# Loading Data and Packages

```{python}
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.cluster import KMeans
from sklearn.metrics import silhouette_score
from sklearn.decomposition import PCA

full_df = pd.read_csv(
    "data/full_df.csv",
    parse_dates=["weekdate"]
)

full_df = full_df.sort_values("weekdate").reset_index(drop=True)

features = [
    "temp_avg",
    "temp_max",
    "temp_min",
    "precip_total",
    "humidity_avg"
]

```

# K-Means Clustering

## Standardize Climate Variables

```{python}
scaler = StandardScaler()

X_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(full_df[features])
```

## Determine Optimal Number of Clusters

```{python}

k_values = range(2, 11)
inertias = []
silhouette_scores = []

for k in k_values:
    kmeans = KMeans(
        n_clusters=k,
        random_state=42,
        n_init=10
    )

    labels = kmeans.fit_predict(X_scaled)

    inertias.append(kmeans.inertia_)
    silhouette_scores.append(
        silhouette_score(X_scaled, labels)
    )

# Plot elbow method and silhouette scores
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12, 4))

axes[0].plot(k_values, inertias, marker="o")
axes[0].set_xlabel("Number of Clusters (k)")
axes[0].set_ylabel("Inertia")
axes[0].set_title("Elbow Method")

axes[1].plot(k_values, silhouette_scores, marker="o")
axes[1].set_xlabel("Number of Clusters (k)")
axes[1].set_ylabel("Silhouette Score")
axes[1].set_title("Silhouette Analysis")

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()


```

## Fit K-Means Model

```{python}

kmeans_final = KMeans(
    n_clusters=2,
    random_state=42,
    n_init=10
)

full_df["cluster"] = kmeans_final.fit_predict(X_scaled)

full_df["cluster"].value_counts().sort_index()

```

## Analyze Dengue Incidence by Cluster

```{python}
cluster_summary = full_df.groupby("cluster").agg(
    weeks=("conf_cases", "count"),
    mean_cases=("conf_cases", "mean"),
    median_cases=("conf_cases", "median"),
    max_cases=("conf_cases", "max"),
    avg_temp=("temp_avg", "mean"),
    avg_precip=("precip_total", "mean"),
    avg_humidity=("humidity_avg", "mean")
)

cluster_summary.round(2)

```

# Principal Component Analysis (PCA)

## PCA Visualization of Climate Clusters

```{python}
pca = PCA(n_components=2)

X_pca = pca.fit_transform(X_scaled)

full_df["PC1"] = X_pca[:, 0]
full_df["PC2"] = X_pca[:, 1]

print("Explained variance ratio:", pca.explained_variance_ratio_)
print("Total variance explained:", pca.explained_variance_ratio_.sum())

plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))

sns.scatterplot(
    data=full_df,
    x="PC1",
    y="PC2",
    hue="cluster",
    palette="Set2",
    alpha=0.6
)

plt.title("Climate Clusters Visualized Using PCA")
plt.xlabel("Principal Component 1")
plt.ylabel("Principal Component 2")
plt.legend(title="Cluster")

plt.show()

```

## PCA Visualization of Dengue Incidence


```{python}

full_df["case_category"] = pd.cut(
    full_df["conf_cases"],
    bins=[-1, 10, 50, np.inf],
    labels=["Low (0–10)", "Moderate (11–50)", "High (>50)"]
)

plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))

sns.scatterplot(
    data=full_df,
    x="PC1",
    y="PC2",
    hue="case_category",
    palette="viridis",
    alpha=0.6
)

plt.title("Climate PCA Colored by Dengue Incidence")
plt.xlabel("Principal Component 1")
plt.ylabel("Principal Component 2")
plt.legend(title="Weekly Cases")

plt.show()

```

# How Much Each Climate Variable Contributes to Each PC

```{python}

loadings = pd.DataFrame(
    pca.components_.T,
    columns=["PC1", "PC2"],
    index=features
)

loadings.round(3)

```
